subject.title: fix(chat): preserve explicit current-source sends in Control UI history

question: Should OpenClaw adopt `sourceReplyRoute: "current-source"` as authoritative cross-boundary metadata for projecting explicit message sends into the current session’s Control UI history?
rationale: The implementation is coherent and well proven, but the marker establishes a shared session-state contract between separately owned outbound routing and Gateway projection paths.

options.title: Confirm and land the marker contract
